_comment: 100 GB values from the 16-writer trimmed load's server sample (_server/<log-node>/ozonedb-corfu-native_workloadload_w16_rc100000000_trial0.{before,after}.txt). sC = Cassandra data dir after the 100 GB load once compaction settled, 106,889,724 KB / 1.024e11. sO = bucket 121,962 MB (mc du) minus the 167 MB checkpoint prefix, over 1.024e11 (10 GB gave 1.186). L_gb = /mnt/corfu/run_batch at the end of the load with Corfu still up, 52,516 KB = 0.05 GiB (10 GB: 361 MiB with 16 writers). L0_kb_per_put = the untrimmed native reload (1.3 GB per 1 M puts). trim_interval_s = log_trim_interval_ms of the shared config. wa = MinIO bytes received during the load, 4.751e11 / 1.024e11 (10 GB: 3.39).
